fluff.overview: The LCAF fields conventional infantry that benefit from the Commonwealth's deep industrial base, equipping even garrison formations with reliable, well-maintained weapons and transport. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
